changelog: Ordnance goes ballistic. Rockets, artillery, Orbital Strike and Air Strike now AIM AT A TILE (any spot you can see — lob it behind a foe and let the scatter catch them) and may DRIFT a tile off target, blasting an unintended area. A direct hit pierces armor; the splash rings don't. Rockets and artillery reach full accuracy at rank 5; the Air Strike upgrade makes it precise (no drift). Orbital Strike upgraded now saturates a 5x5 area — full damage at the center, 50% on the inner ring, 25% on the outer. Also: fixed the Engineer's free Power Plant sometimes spawning outside the HQ's Command-Point ring; fixed enemies attacking you from empty, fogged tiles and only 'appearing' on your turn (a fog-of-war shooter is now revealed at its firing tile). Mobile HUD is tidier — the top bar no longer stacks awkwardly, the Army panel opens from the Troops pill (its button is gone), and busy action pop-ups are hidden in portrait.
